title: HB 49 (2019-2020 (133th General Assembly)): H. B. No. 49: Authorize concealed handgun license as voter photo identification
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 3501.01(AA)(5)
(quote) or by a county of this state so long as in order to obtain the identification the county required proof of county residency and presentation of a birth certificate, passport, or Ohio driver's license or state identification card
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) 3501.01(D)-(E): other definitions reprinted; a date for March primary and special elections reads differently between the two versions and the reason is not shown in the text
(other) version: 00_IN: adds to the definition of photo identification (3501.01(AA)(5)) a concealed handgun license issued under section 2923.125 or 2923.1213, issued by a county in this state.
(other) version: 01_RH (as reported by House committee): replaces the concealed-handgun-license wording with any identification issued by a county of this state, if the county required proof of county residency and presentation of a birth certificate, passport, or Ohio driver's license or state ID to obtain it. Title changes to 'certain county issued licenses'.
(other) note: Two versions, with markers. It changes one line of the photo identification definition and nothing else on ID. The House committee reported it 13-0 on 2019-11-21 (action list); the skeleton has no roll-call entry, so no vote record is attached. A date line in 3501.01(D)/(E) differs between versions (second Tuesday in 00_IN, third Tuesday in 01_RH, after the first Monday in March); the text does not say why.

sponsors.name: Dave Greenspan
sponsors.version: As Reported by the House State and Local Government Committee (01_RH)
